turns.tutor:

Hmm, who? "She". She needs -s on the verb. So: cooks.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He cooks at home. Wrong: He cook at home.
Your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
